title: The Prophecy of Return and Restoration
description: The Lord commands Jeremiah to write down the prophecy that He will turn the fate of Israel and Judah and bring them back to their land. After a time of distress for Jacob, the Lord will break the yoke and chains, and the people will serve the Lord and a king from David's line. Even though the wound is deep because of sin, God promises to heal Zion, rebuild the city, and renew the covenant: "You shall be my people, and I will be your God."
